description: One judge: how the cases they decided ended (closures in the last ~11 months), motion grant rates by motion family, and trial and verdict figures.

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

name: get_judge

cases.description: Cases where the judge decided the disposition or ruled on a motion.

casesByYear.description: Cases counted by the year they were filed.

closedFrom.description: First disposition date counted, inclusive. Outcome counts here cover only cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo, not all time.

closedTo.description: Last disposition date counted, inclusive: the dataset as-of date.

dispositions.description: Cases whose disposition this judge decided and that closed from closedFrom to closedTo, by how they ended. Counts only cases closed in the 330 days ending at the as-of date (closedFrom to closedTo): the court removes withdrawn cases about a year after withdrawal, so only the last ~11 months of closures are complete. A district last fetched before the as-of date contributes closures only up to its fetch date, a slightly shorter window; the closures it does contribute are still complete.

key.description: Judge key, for get_judge and the judge_key filter.

rulingsByMotionFamily.description: The judge's motion rulings by kind of motion, over every ruling on record.

decided.description: Of those, rulings that decided the motion: granted, denied or granted in part.

grantRate.description: granted / decided; null when none were decided.

trialFigures.description: Tried cases, verdict counts and rates, median net verdict in cents, median days from filing to trial and to closed pleadings.

contactUrl.description: Contact form for asking about more access.

limitReached.description: Present only past the daily profile limit.

resetsAt.description: When the limit resets: the next UTC midnight, ISO 8601.

title: Judge profile
